scene.narration: With no natural predators to keep them in check, the toads marched, westward across the top of the continent, roughly forty to sixty kilometres a year. They reached Brisbane by 1945 and the tip of Cape York by 1994. Back in that first Gordonvale enclosure, a captive toad had promised a beetle fix. Now nothing could pull them back.
